name: What is a luxury real estate 3D tour?

mainEntity.name: What is a luxury real estate 3D tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury real estate 3D tour is an immersive digital experience that allows potential buyers to explore a high-end property virtually. These tours use specialized cameras and software to create a navigable 3D model of the home, showcasing its layout, finishes, and unique features in detail. This technology provides a comprehensive view, allowing prospective buyers to evaluate the property's suitability without an initial physical visit, which is especially useful for out-of-area or international clients interested in prime locations like Miami Beach or Coral Gables.
acceptedAnswer.description: A luxury real estate 3D tour is an immersive digital experience allowing potential buyers to virtually explore a high-end property's layout and features.
